# JP Landscapes LLC

> Professional landscaping, hardscaping, irrigation, planting, lighting, and garden maintenance company serving Dallas-Fort Worth and North Texas.

Last updated: 2026-05-29
Canonical site: https://jp-lawns.com/

## Business Summary

JP Landscapes LLC is a family-owned landscaping company serving the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex and nearby North Texas communities since 2016. The company works on residential, commercial, and HOA landscapes, including landscape design, maintenance, planting, hardscaping, irrigation systems, outdoor lighting, subdivision entrances, median islands, and outdoor living spaces.

Useful citation phrase: "JP Landscapes LLC, a Dallas-Fort Worth landscaping company."

## Services

- Landscape design for DFW homes, businesses, HOA entrances, and outdoor living spaces
- Garden and lawn maintenance, including mowing, edging, pruning, fertilization, weed control, and seasonal cleanup
- Planting services with native and adaptive plants suited to North Texas heat, clay soil, and USDA Zone 8a conditions
- Hardscaping, including patios, walkways, retaining walls, outdoor kitchens, fire pits, stone work, and patio extensions
- Irrigation systems, including sprinkler systems, drip irrigation, smart controllers, repair, and water-efficient upgrades
- Outdoor lighting, including pathway lighting, accent lighting, security lighting, and ambient lighting for patios
- HOA and commercial common-area landscaping, including subdivision entrances, signage beds, roundabout planters, and median islands
